name: print-social-orange-construction-post-set-with-swoosh-and-arrow-tags
title: Six construction posts in orange, black and white with a swoosh ribbon, arrow glyphs and helmets
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid mixing dark photo posts of engineers in orange helmets with an orange swoosh ribbon across, a white post with concrete architecture and an orange arrow, a house held in a hand, an excavator silhouette on white, a chess piece, and headlines in bold sans with orange keywords and small arrow icons.
whatItMeans: Confident and industrial; the orange ribbon ties photography across posts.
techniques: Run an orange swoosh across photos.
Use a small orange arrow glyph beside headlines.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured highlight behind a word.
